formula-ev-lv.description: Lead low-voltage electrical systems for a university Formula EV team. Manage power distribution, control modules, and sensor integration while coordinating with mechanical and software teams.

altagas-coop.description: Developed data pipelines, automation tools, and technical systems across corrosion monitoring, asset management, and inspection planning for multi-facility operations.

spartan-controls-technician.description: Built electrical panels from design through assembly and QC. Loaded control module software, performed pre-delivery quality assurance, and managed projects from issue to customer delivery.

corrosion-monitoring-dashboard.description: Built a centralized data pipeline in Microsoft Fabric to automate corrosion coupon tracking across 12 facilities with 100+ monitored assets, replacing manual vendor report processing.

image.alt: AltaGas facility inspection with team members examining equipment

inspection-scope-tool.description: Developed a Python-based tool using openpyxl and python-docx to automate creation of 500+ equipment-specific inspection scopes from database exports, reducing manual creation time by 95%.

heat-exchanger-lifecycle-analysis.description: Analyzed 2+ years of operating data for 12+ brazed aluminum heat exchangers to assess fatigue risk, identify monitoring gaps, and recommend operational changes to extend asset life.

formula-ev-electrical-systems.description: Leading low-voltage electrical design and integration for a university Formula EV team, managing power distribution, sensor networks, and control system coordination.
